title: Stable semantic identity is not a pathname
summary: SSC identifies package/class/method/attribute/constant/external-operation entities independently of carrier path. Gopher should display both physical locator evidence (archive/nested/member/path) and semantic identity (component/lineage/source level/entity/revision) rather than collapsing one into the other.
invariants: Renaming or moving a source file is not itself a semantic entity change.
Class-side, instance-side and object-scope trial methods remain distinct identities.
Duplicate package-local definitions are compared as semantic multisets when a qualified name is ambiguous.
Historical accepted source bytes remain immutable when a newer analyzer learns additional semantic surface.
